name: What is the typical timeline for a tiny home interior design project?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for a tiny home interior design project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a tiny home interior design project can vary based on complexity, client decisions, and material availability. Typically, the design phase (initial consultation, concept development, and revisions) might take 4-8 weeks. The procurement and installation phase can then range from 6-12 weeks, depending on custom elements and contractor schedules. A complete project, from initial concept to move-in, often spans 3-6 months.
acceptedAnswer.description: A tiny home interior design project typically takes 3-6 months from concept to completion, including 4-8 weeks for design and 6-12 weeks for installation.
